title: zaluzianskya capensis
intro: Zaluzianskya capensis, commonly known as Cape Marigold, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the genus Zaluzianskya. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Zaluzianskya capensis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
